cues.text: You, Yukari and Junpei walk on toward a coffin standing at the far end of the car. Beside it a Shadow appears: a spindly thing on many thin legs, its face hidden behind a boxy mask. All three of you take fighting stances.
The Shadow turns and scuttles away down the car, out through the door at its end.
Junpei runs off after it, through the door and into the next car.
Two more of the masked Shadows have risen up behind you. You and Yukari spin round to face them and raise your guard.
